title: French Quarter, Voodoo, and Vampire History Tour
includes: Walking History Tour through the Frenchman Quarter
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Not recommended for travelers that cannot walk and stand for 45 minutes in duration.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: I offer immersive walking tours where we meander through neighborhoods from one end to the other: French Quarter history, voodoo, and vampire legends. Expect an hour and forty-five minutes of engaging, humorous storytelling with a break for coffee or drinks. ☕ I spill the tea—the dirt, the crevices, the lagniappe they don't put on postcards. In New Orleans, the truth is always more interesting than the legend. ⚜️
